brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the Qate'a neighborhood on the outskirts of Shebaa in the Hasbaya district of southern Lebanon early Monday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The soldiers entered a house and abducted two brothers, then transported them into Israeli territory.

The abduction marks the latest incident in the border area, which has seen repeated Israeli military incursions into Lebanese territory.

title: Israeli forces abduct two brothers from southern Lebanon
